driveQueue.title: Instagram from Drive folder
driveQueue.description: Post one image per day from a Google Drive to-post folder — captions promote this business profile, then the file moves to posted.
driveQueue.icloudNote: iCloud shared albums have no server API here — sync the album into Google Drive (or copy files into the to-post folder) first.
driveQueue.reconnectNote: Reconnect Google Drive once so the app can move files after posting.
driveQueue.enableHint: Posts once per day when the Automations schedule is due (default ~09:00).
driveQueue.folderPlaceholder: Folder name, ID or Drive URL
driveQueue.daysAheadHint: Each cron run fills missing days up to this window (one image per day).
driveQueue.abTesting: A/B test captions (pick between two variants)
driveQueue.matchShopify: Match filename to Shopify products in captions
driveQueue.useVision: Describe the image with AI vision (AI mode)
driveQueue.previewAiNote: Live AI captions are written at enqueue time from Company profile + image (vision when enabled).
driveQueue.remainingImages: {{count}} images left in to-post (after last run)
driveQueue.scheduleHint: Fine-tune days and time under Automations → Content → Instagram from Drive folder.

guide.title: How it works
guide.step1: Create two Drive folders: to-post (queue) and posted (archive).
guide.step2: Drop product/lifestyle photos into to-post — oldest posts first.
guide.step3: Each day we schedule one image to Instagram with a caption for this company profile.
guide.step4: After a successful post the file is moved to posted so it never repeats.
guide.trust: Nothing posts until Instagram is connected via Zernio and the schedule is enabled.
guide.example: Example caption: “Summer drop — Acme Studio. Link in bio. #smallbusiness”
